_comment: Config for deploy/New-AuditRetentionPolicy.ps1. Author-only reference data. Defines custom Microsoft Purview audit log retention policies via Set-/New-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy. Each entry is reconciled independently (create if missing, update if the live policy's settings differ) - safe to re-run.

policies.name: Extended-Teams-Audit-1Year
policies.description: One-year retention for all Microsoft Teams activity - Teams is not covered by the Audit (Premium) default retention policy (Entra/Exchange/SharePoint/OneDrive only), so this closes that gap for regulated collaboration data.

policies.name: SixMonth-AdminLogons
policies.description: Six-month retention for admin sign-in events, scoped to the break-glass/global-admin account - a narrower, user-scoped policy layered over the broader Teams policy above.

policies.name: ThreeMonth-SharePointSearchNoise
policies.description: Shortens retention for a high-volume, low-investigative-value SharePoint activity (search queries) generated by a service account, so it doesn't consume audit storage/search-result budget at the full 1-year default. Mirrors Microsoft's own worked example.

_priorityNote: Priority is a tenant-wide, globally unique integer across ALL custom audit log retention policies (1 = highest priority, 10000 = lowest). New-AuditRetentionPolicy.ps1 checks every entry in this file against every OTHER live policy in the tenant (not just entries in this file) before applying anything - see README.md Section 6 and design.md Section 4.
_retentionDurationNote: PowerShell only accepts ThreeMonths | SixMonths | NineMonths | TwelveMonths | TenYears (Set-/New-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy -RetentionDuration enum). The portal additionally offers 7 Days, 30 Days, 3 Years, 5 Years, and 7 Years - those five durations CANNOT be created or edited through this script or any PowerShell cmdlet; use the Microsoft Purview portal instead. See README.md Section 11.
_tenYearsNote: TenYears requires the 10-Year Audit Log Retention add-on license on every user whose activity the policy covers, in addition to an E5-family license. This script cannot verify that license assignment - confirm it manually before relying on a TenYears policy (README.md Section 3).
